focus: mimo-07: New commands and workflows the operator would actually use

label: Exactly three surfaces remove an operator decision: a confirm-mode stop suggestion, a survival-ordered P0 reread, and done-gate advisory suppression, each default-off behind its own measurement gate
No new command or hub mode earns existence: a jev-judge surface adds routing without removing a decision, and a harness command is a forwarding wrapper over scripts
The D4 grader agreement row passes the proof test but fails the removes-a-decision test; it is measurement infrastructure and must not be sold as a UX win
The done gate's proof plan must accept a measured regex fix with zero Jev runtime code as a passing outcome, since the cheapest reversal-cost move may win outright

Every surface that calls Jev must print an egress announcement before its first call, and the recipes' PR-claims gate is later-only because it is jevctl-shaped and would insert a send into the merge flow with no gold
